message:
Hey neighbors! 🌟 We all know that preparing for emergencies can feel a bit overwhelming, especially when we think about our kids. But having a solid plan can turn that anxiety into confidence. 

This resource is a great way to spark conversations in our family group chat. We can all share our thoughts, ideas, and any fun family drills we want to try together. 

Let’s make sure everyone feels included and knows what to do when the unexpected happens. After all, preparedness can be a family bonding experience! How do you make these conversations fun at home?
